integrity: A self-contained analytic proof is supplied; finite-state and numerical diagnostics corroborate but do not certify infinite limits. Independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The exact period-two complementary profile, fair first step, and full-uniform-memory selection are essential; there is no quantitative Gaussian approximation or simultaneous varying-parameter limit. The constant C_delta is given as a convergent sequence, and priority could be affected by an unlocated general second-order theorem.
title: A hidden logarithmic variance deficit under alternating elephant-walk memory
